name: How much does a garage conversion typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a garage conversion typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a garage conversion varies widely depending on the scope, finishes, and the existing condition of the garage. Factors like adding plumbing for a bathroom or kitchen, extensive electrical upgrades, new windows, insulation, and high-end finishes will increase the overall price. Generally, basic conversions can start from $40,000, while more complex ADU conversions with kitchens and bathrooms can range significantly higher. Obtaining detailed quotes from contractors is essential.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely based on scope and finishes, typically starting from $40,000 for basic conversions and increasing for complex ADUs.
